name: Tsuihou Senkyo
source:
The game takes places in an abandoned amusement park. The game's characters are trapped within the park, with the outside world being in a post-apocalyptic wasteland infested with murderous monsters. Within the park, the game's thirteen main characters are held captive by a mysterious mechanical doll named "Alice", who holds the "death games", which basically force the characters against each other for survival - the losers being exiled back out into the world. Alice refuses to stop the games until only two characters are alive and present. The game's protagonist is Kaname Ichijou, a young man who has the ability to see sound as colors, and sees spoken falsehoods in the color of red. He also harbors a grudge against most of the rest of the characters of the game for allowing the exile of his little sister.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exile_Election]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在一个废弃的游乐园里。游戏中的角色被困在公园内，而外面的世界则是一片充满凶残怪物的后世界末日荒原。在公园内，游戏的十三名主要角色被一个名叫“爱丽丝”的神秘机械娃娃俘虏，她举行“死亡游戏”，基本上迫使角色为了生存而相互对抗 - 失败者被放逐回世界。爱丽丝拒绝停止游戏，直到只有两个角色还活着并在场。游戏的主角是一条要（Kaname Ichijou），他是一位拥有将声音视为颜色的能力的年轻人，并能以红色看到所说的谎言。他还对游戏中的大多数其他角色怀有怨恨，因为他们允许流放他的妹妹。

[来自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exile_Election]维基百科[/url]]
